title: Clayton Utz adopts Harvey in next step of AI journey
summary: Clayton Utz announced firmwide adoption of Harvey. Its announcement identifies contract review, drafting, due diligence, extraction and summarisation as intended uses.
evidenceQuote: Clayton Utz is proud to announce its firmwide adoption of Harvey

title: CMS announces roll out of Harvey across 50+ countries
summary: CMS announced expanded Harvey access across its 21 member firms in more than 50 countries, covering over 7,000 lawyers and staff. These are the firm's reported rollout figures.
evidenceQuote: providing over 7,000 CMS lawyers and staff with access to the latest AI-powered tools

title: Latham announces firmwide deployment of Harvey
summary: Latham announced an enterprise licence for a global Harvey rollout to lawyers and related business professionals. The announcement describes research, document analysis and drafting among the intended uses.
evidenceQuote: signed an enterprise license for firmwide rollout of the Harvey platform

title: MinterEllison expands suite of AI tools to unlock the power of human + AI
summary: MinterEllison announced a partnership with Legora. The firm describes an existing AI tool set that includes Microsoft Copilot and its internally developed Lantern platform.
evidenceQuote: MinterEllison has partnered with Legora, marking the next phase of its AI strategy

title: Willkie announces global rollout of Harvey
summary: Willkie announced firmwide Harvey access beginning in September 2025 and planned integration with its own Wendell Intelligence platform. It also announced an innovation partnership involving early product testing.
evidenceQuote: Harvey will also be integrated directly into Willkie’s proprietary AI platform, Wendell Intelligence

title: Crowell & Moring reports six months of Legora integration
summary: Crowell reported over two million Legora interactions following its January 2026 launch, and said 91% of its attorneys had become users. These are firm-reported adoption figures, not independently verified performance results.
evidenceQuote: the firm has recorded more than two million interactions

title: Latham and Harvey collaborate on AI-enabled fund formation
summary: Latham and Harvey announced a design partnership to develop an AI-enabled fund formation solution. The stated scope includes limited partnership agreements, side letters, subscription documents and comment memoranda; the announcement describes development rather than a completed public product.
evidenceQuote: announced a collaboration to develop an AI-enabled fund formation solution
